description: Read the simulated fills stored for a sandbox_id (from sandbox_run, or any Alert Sandbox webhook id), newest first. No token, no account, no key: simulation only, no real order was placed. Returns { sandbox: true, real_order_placed: false, notice, sandbox_id, alerts: [{ received_at, seq?, orders?: [same shape as sandbox_run orders, including fill.status (filled, not_filled or no_price), fill.origin, fill.price_label, fill.price_warning and fill.price_error], error? }], more } where more is true when older alerts exist beyond this page. A refusal returns { error, code, fix }: bad_sandbox_id (malformed id), sandbox_refused (e.g. the id belongs to an account), sandbox_rate_limited, sandbox_bad_answer, sandbox_unreachable, sandbox_timeout, internal_error. Do what fix says.

sandbox_id.description: the sandbox id sandbox_run returned: 32 lowercase hex, e.g. "6d43316194e3727e2411ef118974be1f"
